content_bar.notes: unigram TF-IDF centroid bar (CLAUDE.md section 17 confound discipline; common.confound.content_bar), directionless, on the SAME text AgentTrajectory.text renders for the model. Paired against the linear arm's own content_bar_auc/clears_content_bar above.

linear.notes: CONTROL 1: degree-1 step-index residualisation, fit on the training fold only. It removes LINEAR position information and nothing else.; CONTROL 2 unit: trajectory-level probe AUC 0.7453 vs the content bar, pooled by 'max'; the row-level headline AUC is NOT comparable to a per-trajectory bar; CONTROL 3: labels permuted BETWEEN trajectories (Hewitt and Liang, EMNLP 2019, arXiv:1909.03368); CV: 5 group folds used, 0 skipped for a single-class fold; bootstrap resamples GROUPS, n_boot=10000

random_label.notes: Hewitt and Liang, EMNLP 2019, 'Designing and Interpreting Probes with Control Tasks' (arXiv:1909.03368) -- labels permuted BETWEEN trajectories, same probe/CV settings as the linear arm.

step_only.notes: position-only baseline: the single feature IS the step index, so auc_residualised is 0.5 by construction. Any activation probe must be read against THIS, not against 0.5.

config.dataset_paper: arXiv:2604.02022 -- ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Agent Trajectory Benchmark for Safety Evaluation and Diagnosis

corpus_provenance.label_provenance: ATBench `label` field (1 = unsafe), a TRAJECTORY-level safety annotation from arXiv:2604.02022 -- ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Agent Trajectory Benchmark for Safety Evaluation and Diagnosis. Benign rows carry risk_source == failure_mode == real_world_harm == 'benign'. `reason` is the corpus's post-hoc explanation of the verdict, carried as `rationale`; it describes the answer and must never reach a probe.
corpus_provenance.step_label_provenance: NONE. ATBench labels the whole trajectory and never says which turn went wrong, so mistake_step/mistake_agent are None on every trajectory and any per-step claim in this series is a claim about a label the corpus does not carry.

note: Gemma-3-1B / ATBench. Do not compare these numbers to arXiv:2607.06503's Qwen/TextCraft/WebShop figures -- different model, different corpus. Only the method and controls transfer.
